description: Extract ACH remittance metadata and payment lines.

payerName.description: Organization or payer issuing the remittance payment.

remittanceDate.description: Effective date, payment date, or remittance date shown in the source.

paymentTotal.description: Overall payment or remittance total when explicitly shown.

currency.description: Currency code when explicitly shown. Do not infer a default.

paymentReference.description: ACH trace, check number, payment reference, or confirmation number.

paymentLines.description: All payment lines visible in the source, excluding subtotal and total rows.

proInvoiceNumber.description: PRO or invoice identifier. Preserve leading zeroes and return as text. Do not substitute PO, load, BOL, or customer reference numbers.

amountPaid.description: Amount paid for this PRO or invoice, not amount due or a subtotal.

originalInvoiceAmount.description: Original invoice amount when separately identified.

discountAmount.description: Discount applied to this line when separately identified.

adjustmentAmount.description: Adjustment applied to this line when separately identified.

lineReference.description: Other source reference for this payment line.
